explanations.title: Validates inputs and bounds file reads
explanations.summary: Rejects invalid tenant or revision identifiers, unsafe paths, invalid line ranges, and oversized reviewed files before comparing revisions.

explanations.title: Detects edits without treating line shifts as fixes
explanations.summary: Checks whether the reviewed lines still occur together anywhere in the merged file, so insertions above them do not count as addressing the review. Changed lines or a deleted file do count as addressed.

explanations.title: Fingerprints the reviewed snippet
explanations.summary: Returns a SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact reviewed snippet, allowing callers to identify which original lines were checked.
